name: ecohotel-norcasia
description: EcoHotel Madeguadua (Norcasia, Caldas): sitio web y panel de administración con backend propio.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
